documents.title: Enterprise support policy
documents.text: Enterprise support is available 24 hours a day. Tickets receive a response within 2 hours.

documents.title: Billing policy
documents.text: Annual subscriptions are billed in advance. Billing disputes must be submitted within 30 days.

documents.title: Onboarding policy
documents.text: New employees complete security training within 7 days. Managers approve access requests.
